exclusion_sources: every canonical id with any persisted assessment row in any track database
the frozen Batch-3 roster, attempted or not
every canonical id with saved operator run artifacts, including a started primary call with no stored row
DOI, arXiv and OpenAlex aliases of all of the above, across tracks
eligible_population.commitment_definition: SHA-256 over the newline-joined sorted canonical ids of the eligible population for that track

execution_eligibility.nature: deterministic execution eligibility, not a scientific-quality filter
execution_eligibility.applied: at selection time, before the roster freezes and before any model call
execution_eligibility.failure_handling: a paper failing acquisition or the coverage gate is recorded as outside the Batch-4 evaluation population and is replaced by the next eligible paper in deterministic order; it is not a batch outcome and does not consume a roster slot

selection_rule.ordering: the existing offline research ranking used for Batch 3: production duplicate merging, rule refresh, existing curation, quality presentation, newness and _sort_latest_relevant; key is newness, high relevance, downrank flag, date bucket/date, combined rank, relevance score, lowercase title
selection_rule.procedure: walk the eligible population in deterministic order, apply the execution-eligibility filter, and take the first papers that pass

freezing.audit_rule: positions 1, floor(n/2)+1 and n in each populated track roster; audit all if n<3, zero if n=0; additionally audit every promotion and every primary-pass/adjudicator-non-pass disagreement after all outcomes are frozen

generalization_scope: Batch-4 results apply to high-relevance papers with retrievable, coverage-valid manuscript evidence. They do not generalize to all discovered papers, and they say nothing about papers whose manuscripts cannot be acquired or whose coverage gate fails.

cost_basis.source: bounded integration smoke on 2026-09-18, two assessable papers, four calls
cost_basis.excluded_from_projection: adjudicator contract retries, which add at most one further adjudication per paper
cost_basis.note: Gemini monetary cost is not reported by the endpoint and the MSc allocation rate is not established in this project. It is recorded as UNKNOWN against the allocation with exact token counts; it is not assumed to be zero and no amount is fabricated.

prohibitions: do not run Batch 4 from this preparation task
do not start recurring production assessment
do not reinterpret or rerun Batch 3
do not publish assessment databases, snapshots or raw execution records
